findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_search_courses, agent_get_course, agent_search_course_content, agent_search, agent_buy_review, agent_list_crosswalk_pairs · Private data: agent_course_contents, agent_search_course_content, agent_cross_framework_map, agent_coverage_report, agent_coverage_crosswalk, agent_crosswalk_provenance, agent_crosswalk_pair, agent_crosswalk_refuted, agent_combined_coverage, agent_buy_review, adoption_get_report · Public sink: agent_get_framework_controls_by_name, agent_buy_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_search_courses, agent_get_course, agent_search_course_content, agent_search, agent_buy_review, agent_list_crosswalk_pairs · Private data: agent_course_contents, agent_search_course_content, agent_cross_framework_map, agent_coverage_report, agent_coverage_crosswalk, agent_crosswalk_provenance, agent_crosswalk_pair, agent_crosswalk_refuted, agent_combined_coverage, agent_buy_review, adoption_get_report · Public sink: agent_get_framework_controls_by_name, agent_buy_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
